topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't believe I found my old teddy bear, the one with the stitched nose and the threadbare fur, right there, abandoned in a stranger's yard sale. I knew it instantly, though it's been decades. It was the only thing that understood my silent fears, the only witness to my childhood sorrows. I don’t know why, but my hands shook as I picked it up, dust and all. It feels like a piece of me, lost and now found again. But the world has moved on, and so have I. What am I supposed to do with this piece of the past? Why does it feel like everything is falling apart when it should be whole again?
